verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says users can "restore to any previous checkpoint from version history", and Linear runs cloud coding sessions in which Linear Agent writes code with Claude Code and Codex. However, the restore snippet never says it applies to coding-agent sessions; it may refer to agent-edited documents or text, so credit is limited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation tying checkpoint restore to coding-agent sessions, detail on what a checkpoint captures (code, files, conversation), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history

citations.quote: If you need to revert to an earlier version, restore to any previous checkpoint from version history.
Coding sessions run in the cloud, so you can prototype ideas and make changes without setting up a local development environment.
Linear Agent can now write code using Claude Code and Codex.
